subject: general
question: Who among the following is known as the 'Mozart of Madras'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AR Rahman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **AR Rahman** is an acclaimed Indian composer, singer, and music producer known for his work in Indian cinema.
 
• He has won several prestigious awards including **two Academy Awards** (Oscars), **two Grammy Awards**, a BAFTA Award, and a Golden Globe.
 
• Rahman was awarded the **Padma Bhushan**, India's third-highest civilian award, in 2010.
 
• He is often referred to as the 'Mozart of Madras' for his contributions to music, especially for blending Eastern classical music with electronic music, world music, and traditional orchestral arrangements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Early Life:**

 
 
• Born as A.S. Dileep Kumar on 6 January 1967 in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, Rahman converted to Islam following the death of his father and changed his name to Allah Rakha Rahman.
 
 
 
• **Debut and Breakthrough:**
 
 
• Rahman made his debut as a film composer with the 1992 Tamil film 'Roja,' directed by Mani Ratnam, which earned him national recognition and numerous awards.
 
 
 
• **International Recognition:**
 
 
• His work on the score for the film 'Slumdog Millionaire' (2008) brought him international fame and several awards, including the Academy Award for Best Original Score and Best Original Song.
 
 
 
• **Philanthropy and Other Ventures:**
 
 
• Besides his musical career, Rahman has also been involved in various philanthropic activities and founded the KM Music Conservatory in Chennai to nurture young musical talents.
